modernity.evidence: Dark purple page with ridged table borders, a letter-spaced red title and striped placeholder boxes.

visual_hierarchy.evidence: The large red title is clear, but below it the content is a dense table with no headings.

mobile_usability.evidence: Wide fixed page scaled onto the phone; text is microscopic and most of the screen is empty purple.

readability.evidence: Dim purple text on dark purple is nearly invisible; one long run-on paragraph in small serif.

imagery_quality.evidence: Three striped boxes labelled with file names like "image.jpg" instead of villa photos.

trust_signals.evidence: Shows "page last updated 03/2011" and "under construction"; only an e-mail address is visible.

cta_clarity.evidence: Tiny blue "click here" links next to a red "NEW!! SPECIAL OFFER" label; no booking button.

brand_consistency.evidence: Red title, bright green subtitle and dim serif body clash with no consistent palette.

summary.en: Outdated, nearly unreadable villa page with placeholder images, an old update date and no clear booking path. Unusable on mobile.
summary.fr: Page de villa obsolète et presque illisible, avec des images factices, une date de mise à jour ancienne et aucun parcours de réservation. Inutilisable sur mobile.
